text.label: Mingyu Bian studies Intelligent Science and Technology at
's School of Future Technology. He is also a Zero One Scholar in the joint program of
text.label_zh: 未来技术学院智能科学与技术专业本科生，也是

text.label: . His research focuses on
text.label_zh: 联合培养的零一学者。他的研究方向是

text.label: , with an emphasis on developing computational methods to understand complex living systems and support scientific inference.
text.label_zh: ，致力于发展用于理解复杂生命系统和支持科学推断的计算方法。

biography.text: During the semester, he pairs coursework at Xinjiang University with research training through ESRT and ORIC, applying what he learns in class to his research.
biography.text_zh: 学期内，他以新疆大学的专业课程和联合培养项目的科研训练（ESRT、ORIC）为两条主线，把课堂所学用于研究。

biography.heading: Direction 1 · Modeling Genomic Regulation and Molecular Conformation
biography.heading_zh: 方向一 · 基因组调控与分子构象建模
biography.text: He uses genomic prediction and RNA language models to study traits and molecular function.
biography.text_zh: 结合基因组预测与 RNA 语言模型，研究遗传变异与性状、分子构象与功能的关系。

biography.heading: Direction 2 · Structured Machine Learning and Interpretable Inference
biography.heading_zh: 方向二 · 结构化机器学习与可解释推断
biography.text: He models outcome dependencies and fixed-sum constraints for interpretable prediction.
biography.text_zh: 将预测目标间的依赖和组分比例的总和约束纳入模型，考察其对预测与解释的作用。

biography.heading: Direction 3 · Prediction and Decision-Making under Uncertainty
biography.heading_zh: 方向三 · 不确定性下的预测与决策
biography.text: He studies test timing and evaluates models trained on synthetic data in a real cohort.
biography.text_zh: 评估测量误差对检测时点的影响，并在真实队列中检验合成数据训练的筛查模型。

biography.text: His manuscripts are under review at journals including Horticulture Research. His conference papers have been published or submitted for review in the main tracks of ICIC, CITSC, ABCM, AAAI, and ICLR. He welcomes discussions on shared research interests.
biography.text_zh: 研究成果发表/在审于 Horticulture Research 等期刊，在 ICIC、CITSC、ABCM、AAAI、ICLR 等计算机主会上发表/在审，欢迎就共同感兴趣的研究课题交流探讨。

items.title: Xinjiang University
details: Undergraduate in Intelligence Science and Technology, School of Future Technology.

Coursework includes Advanced Mathematics, Linear Algebra, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, Data Structures and Algorithms, Advanced Programming (Python), Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Software Engineering, Microcontrollers and Interface Technology, and Image Signal Processing.
English: CET-4 453; English Test for International Communication (ETIC), CLA-Basic Pass.
details_zh: 未来技术学院智能科学与技术专业本科
主要课程包括高等数学、线性代数、概率论与数理统计、数据结构与算法、高级程序设计（Python）、机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、软件工程、单片机与接口技术和图像信号处理等。
英语能力：CET-4 453 分，国际人才英语考试（ETIC）CLA-Basic 通过。

items.title: Tsinghua Qian Xuesen Program & Shenzhen X-Institute
items.title_zh: 清华大学钱学森班与深圳零一学院
details: Zero One Scholar in the joint training program. The research training curriculum comprises ESRT, ORIC, and SURF.
details_zh: 联合培养零一学者。科研训练包括 ESRT、ORIC 和 SURF。

items.title: Institute of High Energy Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
items.title_zh: 中国科学院高能物理研究所
details: Built a neutron spectrometer acquisition prototype and software using DMA readout and concurrent GPU processing for image analysis and runtime monitoring.
details_zh: 搭建中子谱仪 GPU 流式采集样机和软件框架，通过 DMA 读出和 GPU 并发处理实现图像分析及运行监测。

items.title: Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences
items.title_zh: 中国科学院软件研究所
details: Built MemoDroid, a three-tier memory plug-in for LLM-based GUI testing, and evaluated it on at least 200 real apps across 15 categories.
details_zh: 开发面向大语言模型 GUI 测试的三层记忆插件 MemoDroid，并在覆盖 15 类的至少 200 个真实应用中完成评估。

items.title: Shenzhen Bay Laboratory
details: Applied contrastive learning to RESM's downstream tasks and investigated how to integrate multiple types of RNA data into the model.
details_zh: 将对比学习应用于 RNA 语言模型 RESM 的下游任务，并研究如何在模型中整合多种 RNA 信息。

items.title: Plant counting and replanting decisions from drone imagery
items.title_zh: 无人机影像作物计数与补种决策
details: Team lead, Undergraduate Innovation Training Program. Proposed a lightweight detector, aerial imaging, and GIS workflow to count plants and map missing seedlings for replanting.
details_zh: 大学生创新训练计划团队第一负责人。提出结合轻量目标检测、无人机影像和 GIS 的方案，统计植株数量并绘制缺苗位置，以辅助补种。

items.title: Open-source processor design
details: Primary team lead. Recreated RISC-I and Cray-I architecture designs using open-source EDA tools and built a RISC-V vector arithmetic prototype.
details_zh: 团队第一负责人。使用开源 EDA 工具复现 RISC-I 和 Cray-I 架构设计，实现 RISC-V 矢量算术原型。
